name: They Cannot Hear Me
source:
It's the middle of Winter and a lonely man goes for a walk thinking about how sad his life has become.

[From [url=https://rehncohro.itch.io/they-cannot-hear-me]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
隆冬时节，一个孤独的男人去散步，想着他的生活变得多么悲伤。

[来自[url=https://rehncohro.itch.io/they-cannot-hear-me]Itch.io[/url]]
